chapter.verse: Jesu Khris ii sawltak khat ahi keimah Peter in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia leh Bithynia gamke-te ah pemta bangin a kithehthang teeltuam mite ahi,

Pa Pasian' geelkholhsa tawh kizui-in Jesu Khris' thu a mang ding leh ama' sisan tawh a kitheh dingin Kha tawh siansuahna a ngahte kong hopih hi. Note' tungah hehpihna leh nopna lemna hong khang ta hen.
I Topa Jesu Khris ii Pa ahi Pasian in thupha ngah ta hen. Amah in misite' lakpan Jesu Khris' thawhkikna tungtawnin a thukhualna lianpi tawh a nungta lametna sungah eite hong suakkiksak a,
tua pen note' adinga vantung ah a kikoihcing, a siatheilo, ninbaanglo, a muallo gamh ahi hi.
Note pen sehtuam hun nunung cianga lahkhiat dingin a kibawlkhol hotkhiatna thu na upna uh hangin Pasian' vangliatna tawh hong kikembit ahi hi.
Tu-in zia-etna namkim huhau-in tawmvei sung lunggim kul ahih hangin a tunga thu hangin a lungdam na hi uh hi.

Lunggim a kulna pen-a siathei kham nangawn mei tawh a kisittel hi a, tua sangin a manphazaw ahi-na upna uh maan ahihlam kilangkhia-in Jesu Khris hong kilaak hun ciangin phatna, minpha leh pahtawina a ngah nading ahi hi.
Amah na muh ngeiloh uh hangin na it uh hi. Tu laitak amah na muh loh uh hangin amah na um uh a, minpha tawh a kidim, genzawhloh nuamna tawh na lungdam uh hi.
Tua pen note' nunna khate in hotkhiatna ngah ahih man hi a, note' upna gah ahi hi.
Hih hotkhiatna tawh kisai-in note' ngah ding hehpihna thu a genkhol kamsangte in limtak sittelin na kantel uh a,
amau' sunga om Khris' Kha in Khris' gimthuaknate leh tua khit nunga minphatna thute a genkholh pen kua a ci nuam cih ahi zongin, bang hun a gen nuam cih ahi zongin na entel uh hi.

Tua banga a sep uh pen note' ading hi a, amau' ading ahihloh lam zong amau' tungah kilak khin hi. Tua amau' sep thu i cih pen tu-a note' kianga Lungdamna Thu hong tangko mite in vantung pana hong kisawl Kha Siangtho tawh hong pulakkhiat uh thute hi pah a, vanmite in zong theihtel ding a ut mahmah uh thulelate ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin na lungsim kawnggak uh gak unla lungsim tei sinsenin Jesu Khris' hong kilaak hun ciangin note' kiangah hong kitunpih ding ahi hehpihna tungah na lametna uh a bupin nga un.
A thumang naupangte bang hi unla, nidanga theihloh huhau-a na neih uh lunggulhnate kilawhsak kei un.
Note hong samkhiapa siangtho ahih mah bangin note zong na gamtat luhekna khempeuh uhah siangtho un.
A hang pen, “Kei siangtho ka hih manin note zong na siangtho ding uh hi,” ci-in kigelh hi.
Tua hi a, guptuam paihtuam nei lo-in mi khat ciat a gamtatna bangbang thu a khen Pasian pen Pa ci-in lo na hih uhleh leitung lengla na hih sung tawntung uh launa tawh gamta un.
Na pupite uh' tungpan na luahsuk uh a taanglamlo gamtat luhekziate pan note hong kitankhia hi a, tua pen a siathei kham leh ngun tawh hilo-in
a sitbaanglo leh a ninbaanglo tuuno sisan bang ahi Khris ii sisan manpha tawh hong kitankhia ahi hi.
Khris pen leitung kilamkip ma-in a kiteelsa himah taleh note' ading cihna tawh khanghun nunungte ah hong kilaakkhia ahi hi.
Note pen Khris' tungtawnin Pasian a um na hi uh a, tua bangin ama' sungah upna leh lametna a nei na hih nadingun Pasian in misite' lakpan Khris thosakin minpha guan hi.
Sanggam ki-itna maan neih theih nadingin thumaan thutak zuihna tawh na nunna kha uh siansuah khin na hih mah bangun khatlekhat lungsim a siangtak tawh nakpi na ki-it un.
Note pen a nungta a omkip Pasian' thu tungtawnin a siathei nam ahilo, a siatheilo khaici tawh khatvei a suakkik khinte na hi uh hi.
A hang pen “Mihing kici peuhmah lopa bang hi a, amau' minphatna zong lopa pak bang hi lel hi. Lopate vul a, pakte pulh hi.
Topa' kammal ahihleh a tawntungin omkip hi.” Tua kammal pen note' kianga hong kitangko Lungdamna Thu ahi hi.
